theorem_title: The base case: a cube-free subset of $\mathbb{Z}/8\mathbb{Z}$ has at most five elements
natural_language_statement:
Every cube-free $A \subseteq \mathbb{Z}/8\mathbb{Z}$ has $|A| \le 5$.

A finite check over all $2^8 = 256$ subsets. The bound is attained by $\{1, 3, 4, 5, 7\}$, which is the mod-8 shadow of the extremal construction, so it is sharp and not slack.
source: Jason Long and Adam Zsolt Wagner, "The largest projective cube-free subsets of Z_{2^n}", arXiv:1810.01225, https://arxiv.org/abs/1810.01225, the $n = 3$ case of Conjecture 5.1
